about: The Sultan role: one public player, always Loyalist. Appoints the Ministers, gives the Decree and holds the Treason track powers. Has no Companion, Intrigue cards, Influence or Ambition.

base.about: Once per game, when Court ends: replace one Minister with any eligible player, even a sealed one. The removed Minister draws 1 Intrigue card.

about: A courtier close to the Sultan, with sway over his Decree.

base.about: Once per game, at the Decree: you choose which Minister it falls on, instead of the Sultan.

favor.about: Once per game: in one wave, play two Intrigue cards instead of one.

about: A courtier who can take over the appointing of Ministers.

base.about: Once per game: this crisis you appoint both Ministers instead of the Sultan, and you may appoint yourself.

favor.about: Always on: gain 1 Influence whenever Hizmet is played while you are a Minister.

about: A courtier who can force Ministers out and bar a rival from office.

base.about: Once per game, on your Objection turn: object for free and choose the replacement yourself. It counts as your Objection.

favor.about: Once per game: name a player. Next crisis they can't become a Minister in any way.

about: A courtier with a claim to a Minister seat and the love of the people.

base.about: Once per game, when Court ends (before the Ferman): take a Minister seat if you are eligible, even a sealed one. The replaced Minister draws 1 Intrigue card.

favor.about: Always on: a player who objects to you gives you the Influence they paid.

about: A courtier who shields a player and reads the sides.

base.about: Once per game, before Court: choose a player. This crisis Intrigue cards can't unseat them and they can't lose Influence, Decree included.

favor.about: Once per game: choose two players other than the Sultan and yourself. Secretly learn whether they are on the same side.

about: A courtier who works in private: a word with the Sultan, a card turned aside.

base.about: Once per game, before the Sultan appoints: talk with the Sultan privately for up to a minute.

favor.about: Once per game, when a wave flips: move one Intrigue card played on you to another player.

about: A courtier who raids other hands and spies on the First Minister.

base.about: Once per game: take a random Intrigue card from another player's hand, then discard down to the hand limit.

favor.about: Once per game, after the Kader step: secretly see the card or cards the First Minister discarded.

about: Wildcard: an outsider to the court who profits from others and reads the Kader deck.

base.about: Once per game: name another player. The next time they gain Influence, you gain 1 too.

favor.about: Once per game: secretly look at the top 3 Kader cards; you may put one on the bottom.

about: Wildcard: a foreign rival who can hand over a seat and plays in any open field.

base.about: Once per game, in the Appoint step before Objections: give your Minister seat to an eligible player and gain 1 Influence.

favor.about: Always on: your Intrigue cards count as cards of an open field.

about: Wildcard: a foreign rival who picks the field of a crisis and can wipe every hand.

base.about: Once per game, when the Crisis card flips: choose this crisis's field (Divan, Harem or both). Its draw stays as printed.

favor.about: Once per game: every player, you included, keeps 1 Intrigue card of their choice and discards the rest.
